author: darkworl3
quote: They sold us something very different; graphically it's fine, but the bugs and the FPS drops are unbearable. I paid €100 to see what 13 years of work looked like, and this seems more like a job 7 or 8 year.

author: darkworl3
quote: I really love this game; graphically, it's just as good as other companies' AAA games and it runs at 60fps. I highly recommend it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
